return_anchor_scope: Six already used native return anchors plus the same-voltage return partner of the fixed0.975V witness; all occur after outward witness
band_scope: Diagnostic symmetric relative bands on raw RESET and SET read current; not measured uncertainty, noise, or a new scoring gate
table_envelope_scope: Inherited numerical sensitivity, not a newly certified global error bound
gamma_c_source: Exact frozen soft_field_mobility_probe plan value, also used for actual-series state comparison
necessary_excursion: u_return-u_outward >= u(Gamma_return_upper)-u(Gamma_outward_lower); report signed bound, and no positive requirement if nonpositive
inverse_count_definition: Two outward inverses plus seven return inverses in each of two sensitivity scenarios; no direct-spectrum root refinement
inverse_method: Monotone log-current/log-Gamma interpolation within existing frozen negative-polarity table; no table extension or Gamma sweep
actual_series_reference_detail: Use refined_state_u and same-stage JSON plan
input_path_correction: Original reference field accidentally included descriptive text. Failed before any inversion; original script/plan/result/report preserved under pre_reference_path_fix. Only path encoding corrected; same16 problems and physical constants retained
series_comparison: Compare required bare Gamma/u with full actual series-cycle4 SET state range and its maximum-Gamma bare-negative current at the fixed witness voltage. No cross-device initialization or validation claim
broad_gamma_trigger: At least one inferred outward Gamma lower bound exceeds gamma_c or ten times actual-series maximum Gamma

direct_spectrum_check.scope: Check frozen-table inverse currents at selected endpoints; no root refinement, physical fit, or new spectrum selection. Preserve discrepancies exceeding inherited envelope

boundary_policy: Zero outward lower gives no finite u_out upper or positive excursion budget. Outside-table targets are retained unresolved; no extrapolation or clipping. Compare with analytic v/Ron ceiling separately
scope: Pure-loss hard path is an explicit model hypothesis. Background may evolve; Gamma upper from total return current is not an observed soft state. No clocks, species, temperatures, or full-model success inferred
